title: SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY: Online clustering with prototype memory
abstract: This is synthetic demonstration data, not a real thesis. A limitation of online clustering in this demonstration is the fixed memory budget. Future work should evaluate online clustering under recurring concept drift.

title: SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY: Adaptive online clustering
abstract: This is synthetic demonstration data, not a real thesis. An open question concerns online clustering with rare emerging clusters. Further research should evaluate noise robustness in online clustering.
